stores.title: Projects
stores.lede: Shopify projects I built or rebuilt, most of them alone and end to end. Each card is the brand; hover it to see the site as it is live today. When a project has numbers, they come from PageSpeed Insights on mobile, with the date they were measured.
stores.howTo: PageSpeed Insights loads the page on a throttled phone and scores it 0 to 100. Below, the three numbers behind the score, each on a ruler: clear is good, light hatch needs work, dense hatch is poor. Each dot is a store; the red needle is the median.
